notes: All index_0_100 fields are Travelomore editorial indices calibrated on the SAME fixed rubric as every other country catalog (see docs/normalization_rules.md §4) — that shared rubric is what makes a persona mean the same thing in Bangkok and in Dubai. Physical measures (km, hours, °C, ₹, µg/m³) are observed or market-sampled. Every city inherits unspecified signals from country:AE. Note the emirate-level alcohol split: it is real, legally grounded data (Sharjah is dry), not an editorial preference — it is exactly the kind of fact that must live here rather than in engine logic.

entities.name: Dubai
entities.summary: The country's gateway and its most complete city: the world's tallest building, mall-scale shopping treated as a genuine attraction, a desert an hour from the skyline, calm Gulf beaches, the region's best metro, and a licensed nightlife scene — all built for first-timers and priced accordingly.

entities.name: Abu Dhabi
entities.summary: The capital, and the culture-and-family counterweight to Dubai: the Grand Mosque and the Louvre carry genuine gravity, Yas Island holds the region's best theme parks, and the Corniche is a calm, walkable, shallow-water waterfront. Quieter, cheaper and slower than Dubai, with weaker public transport.

entities.name: Sharjah
entities.summary: The UAE's cultural capital and its most conservative emirate: restored heritage quarters, the region's strongest Islamic-art museum, and a souk culture that Dubai has largely replaced with malls. Alcohol is illegal emirate-wide and nightlife effectively does not exist — which makes it the cheapest, quietest and most culturally intact base in the country, and the wrong one for a party trip.

meta.notes: beer_500ml_price_inr is deliberately ABSENT rather than zero or high: alcohol sale is illegal in Sharjah, so no legal price exists to score. A missing attribute drops the alcohol_affordability signal for this city instead of asserting a fabricated one; alcohol_access_index_0_100: 0 is what carries the real constraint.

entities.name: Ras Al Khaimah
entities.summary: The outdoors emirate and the closest the UAE gets to nature travel: Jebel Jais (the country's highest peak) with a genuinely spectacular mountain road, quiet shallow Gulf beaches, and desert camps without the Dubai queue. Cooler, emptier and cheaper than Dubai, but thinner on hospitals and public transport.

meta.notes: max_altitude_m is the CITY baseline (coastal/low foothills), not Jebel Jais — the 1900m summit is a property of the Jebel Jais activity, which carries its own max_altitude_m. Putting the summit altitude here would altitude-gate the entire emirate for pregnancy/senior personas over a single optional day trip.
